instructions.title: HOW TO PLAY
instructions.desktop_controls: WASD or Arrow Keys to move.
instructions.mobile_controls: Use the on-screen D-Pad to move.
instructions.objective_desc: Eat all the dots in the maze to advance to the next level. Avoid the ghosts!
instructions.power_desc: Eat large pellets to turn ghosts blue. Eat them for extra points!
instructions.bonuses_desc: Fruit appears after eating 50 & 70 dots. Eat 100 dots for an Extra Life!
instructions.modes_desc: Toggle between 2D and 3D graphics on the left panel. Visit Settings (⚙️) to try the 'Labadze' theme for a unique Georgian twist!
instructions.camera_desc: In 3D mode, click the 👀/🎥 icon to switch between First-Person and Spectator views.
instructions.camera_note: ⚠️ First-Person (FPS) mode is Desktop only. Use your mouse to look around!
instructions.settings_desc: Click the ⚙️ icon to adjust difficulty, volume, ghost models, and maze colors.
